description: Agenţia Naţională împotriva Traficului de Persoane: road datasets is a collection of datasets listed in data.gov.ro, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by Agenţia Naţională împotriva Traficului de Persoane. Coverage: Agenţia Naţională împotriva Traficului de Persoane. The listing groups 17 datasets under this publisher or service host whose titles are about road; the first few are linked and all are named in the audit file. Examples: Demersuri și acțiuni de informare și conștientizare a traficului de pe; Demersuri/acțiuni de informare și conștientizare a traficului de perso; Date privind victimele traficului de persoane 2023; Date despre prevenirea traficului de persoane aferente anului 2021. Formats seen: XLSX, CSV, XLS. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support transport network, traffic and access studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-data-gov-ro.
